easy.question: In which season do flowers bloom and birds chirp happily?
easy.explanation: Spring (Vasant) is when flowers bloom and birds start singing.

easy.question: In which season do we need umbrellas and raincoats?
easy.explanation: The monsoon (Varsha) is the rainy season when we need umbrellas.

easy.question: In ______, we wear sweaters, shawls, and woollen caps to stay warm.
easy.explanation: Winter (Shishir) is cold, so we wear warm clothes.

easy.question: In which season do we enjoy eating mangoes and watermelon?
easy.explanation: Mangoes and watermelons are summer fruits that help us cool down.

medium.question: Name all five seasons of India with their Hindi names.
medium.explanation: India experiences five distinct seasons throughout the year.

medium.question: Name two festivals celebrated during the monsoon season.
medium.answer: Raksha Bandhan and Janmashtami (or Independence Day on 15th August).
medium.explanation: These festivals fall during the rainy months of July and August.

medium.question: In which season do some leaves turn brown and fall from trees?
medium.explanation: Autumn (Sharad) is when leaves change colour and fall.

hard.question: Match each season with what happens: (a) Vasant (b) Varsha (c) Shishir. Descriptions: We wear sweaters, Peacocks dance in the rain, Flowers bloom everywhere.
hard.answer: (a) Vasant — Flowers bloom everywhere. (b) Varsha — Peacocks dance in the rain. (c) Shishir — We wear sweaters.
hard.explanation: Each season has its own special weather and activities.

easy.question: How many months are there in one year?
easy.explanation: A year has 12 months, from January to December.

easy.question: How many days make one week?
easy.explanation: A week has 7 days: Sunday through Saturday.

easy.question: The very first month of the year is ______.
easy.explanation: January is month number 1 in the calendar.

easy.question: Which month is the shortest, with only 28 or 29 days?
easy.explanation: February has 28 days normally and 29 days in a leap year.

medium.question: Say the 7 days of the week in the correct order.
medium.answer: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.
medium.explanation: These 7 days repeat in a cycle every week.

medium.question: How many days does March have? How many days does June have?
medium.answer: March has 31 days. June has 30 days.
medium.explanation: March is a 31-day month and June is a 30-day month.

medium.question: Republic Day is celebrated on ______ January.
medium.explanation: India celebrates Republic Day on 26th January every year.

hard.question: Name all the months that have exactly 31 days.
hard.answer: January, March, May, July, August, October, December — that is 7 months.
hard.explanation: These 7 months have 31 days each. April, June, September, November have 30 days. February has 28 or 29.

hard.question: Which day comes after Saturday? Which month comes after March?
hard.answer: Sunday comes after Saturday. April comes after March.
hard.explanation: Days and months always follow a fixed order.

easy.question: The SHORT hand on a clock tells us the ______.
easy.explanation: The short hand is the hour hand and shows which hour it is.

easy.question: When the long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 7, the time is ______ o'clock.
easy.explanation: We read the hour from the short hand when the minute hand is at 12.

easy.question: If you face the rising sun in the morning, you are looking towards ______.
easy.explanation: The sun rises in the East.

easy.question: When the short hand points to 4 and the long hand points to 12, what time is it?
easy.explanation: The short hand at 4 and long hand at 12 means it is 4 o'clock.

medium.question: Name the four main directions. How can you find where East is?
medium.answer: North, South, East, West. To find East, face the rising sun in the morning.
medium.explanation: Face the sunrise = East. Behind you = West. Left = North. Right = South.

medium.question: Meera comes home from school at 3 o'clock. She goes to sleep at 9 o'clock at night. How many hours is she at home before sleeping?
medium.answer: From 3 o'clock to 9 o'clock is 6 hours. She is at home for 6 hours before sleeping.

hard.question: If you face East, your back is towards West. Your left hand points to ______ and your right hand points to ______. Name all 4 directions.
hard.answer: Left hand points to North. Right hand points to South. The 4 directions are: North, South, East, West.
hard.explanation: When facing East: behind = West, left = North, right = South.

hard.question: What is a compass and what does it always point to?
hard.answer: A compass is a small tool with a needle that always points to North. It helps us find all four directions.
hard.explanation: A compass works anywhere and at any time to show directions.
